Cc: security@bluebridge.health
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bluebridge support case 5919 - request about conversation retention

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We found one sensitive thread in our account that includes PHI and third-party payroll info. Our legal team would like that single conversation removed from any Redwood audit logs and long-term retention stores. The thread ID on our side is 5919; I believe the support case you opened is SUP-5919.

Can you confirm what you need from us (timestamps, exported thread) and the expected timeline to scrub it from logs and any backup/archives? Also need confirmation you'll update our deletion certificate for our records.

Attachments: redacted-thread-5919-snippet.txt (text)

Thanks,
Sally Jenkins
Privacy & Security Officer
Bluebridge Health
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: sally.jenkins@bluebridge.health, security@bluebridge.health
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bluebridge support case 5919 - request about conversation retention

Hi Sally —

Appreciate the detail. I opened SUP-5919 and attached an export of the thread we captured (support_case_5919_export.zip) and a CSV excerpt of matching audit entries (audit_log_excerpt_5919.csv). To confirm next steps from our side:

- We will target removal of the conversation from active audit indexes and the long-term audit store.
- We need your confirmation that the thread export you provided (and the timestamps inside) are the exact conversation to remove.
- We will perform key-redaction and then a retention scrub which includes removing references from prefetched caches and KV prefixes; however, backups immutable for up to 30 days will be flagged and excluded from any future restores (full immutable deletion is subject to the backup retention window).

Could you reply with a single-line confirmation ("Confirm remove thread 5919") and let us know if you require KMS key rotation as part of the certificate? Once we have confirmation I will schedule the scrub run and send a deletion certificate.

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Bluebridge support case 5919 - request about conversation retention

Jonas — quick internal note before we act: 

- We should escalate to Compliance for a manual scrub because the thread includes flagged PHI markers. Automated retention jobs will skip flagged records until Compliance signs off.
- I'll open an internal Compliance review (CR-2026-084) and add a mandatory checklist: verify external export, freeze retention replication, record audit trail of removal, and issue deletion certificate with a signed timestamp.
- Estimate: 48-72 hours from Compliance approval; we should communicate that to the customer.
